verdict.rationale: Gecko is framed as an 'AI security engineer' that autonomously scans code, generates proof-of-concept exploits and patches, opens PRs, verifies fixes, and files tickets end-to-end (docs-2 to docs-6), which is a form of delegating security tasks to a built-in AI agent rather than a manual tool. However, there is no evidence of an interactive, conversational assistant interface for ad-hoc task delegation, and community reports document real accuracy problems (false positives at 100% confidence, missed real vulnerabilities, silent failures) that undercut trust in the autonomous pipeline. missing for 10: evidence of a chat/assistant UI for arbitrary task delegation, independent validation that the autonomous fix/verify loop reliably works.
